Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating

Early_Morning (optional): Option 3: Any 1 fruit (apple, orange, guava or papaya)
Meal_1: Option 2: Paneer cubes (100 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small bowl ~150 g) + curd (small bowl)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + chicken curry (100–120 g) + vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer curry (100 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + chicken curry (100 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer cubes (100 g) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg omelette (2 eggs) + curd (small bowl)

Notes_and_Tips: Since your activity level is low, include a 30–45 minute walk on most days in addition to yoga.
Keep non-vegetarian meals to 3–4 times per week as per your preference and use paneer or eggs on other days.
Avoid eating late at night whenever possible, as it can increase unnecessary calorie intake.
When attending social gatherings, eat a fruit or a small bowl of curd before leaving home to help control portions.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily and maintain consistent meal timings for better fat loss results.
